arguments.content: Independent-release protocol migrations: updating a client test double to the future provider response can make tests pass while breaking the supported released provider. For receipt/acknowledgement changes, verify both persisted side effects and caller-visible success against the released provider source, even during a client-only task whose provider work is pending. Enforcing a new response field before compatible opt-in/capability gating can report failure after the write already succeeded. Encountered in enhanced-settings task 1: code-reviewer P1, external reviewer CRITICAL; released-provider execution reproduced the false failure.
